result.title: CLEVRER Video Annotations
result.text:
CLEVRER Video Annotations
 This document describes short physics videos from the CLEVRER benchmark. Each video is 128 frames (frame
0 to frame 127, about 5 seconds) showing solid objects sliding on a flat floor and colliding.
Every video has its own chapter titled 'Video <number>'. Questions refer to a video by that number.
Each chapter has three sections. 'Objects' lists every object with its color, material (metal or rubber) and shape
(cube, sphere or cylinder). 'Events' lists, in time order, when objects enter the scene, exit the scene and collide
with each other. 'Motion log' gives sampled positions (x, y) and velocities (vx, vy) on the floor plane for objects
that are visible in the video.
An object is stationary at a frame if its speed is below 0.1; otherwise it is moving. Only what is visible during the
128 frames is recorded; nothing after the video ends is described.
Videos in this document: Video 10017, Video 10232, Video 10517, Video 10769, Video 10967, Video 11102,
Video 11723, Video 11879, Video 12095, Video 12188, Video 13119, Video 13204, Video 13558, Video 13661,
Video 13695, Video 13881, Video 14011, Video 14073, Video 14680, Video 14996.
